articles.title: Yankees need a miracle to win AL East after crushing walk-off loss to Diamondbacks
articles.description: A sweep in next week's four-game set against Tampa Bay is virtually the Yankees' only shot at a division title.

articles.title: The Yankees could taste the 2001 title. Then the Diamondbacks got a World Series-altering tip
articles.description: The Yankees looked poised to win an emotional World Series. Then the Diamondbacks heard a tip about Andy Pettitte that changed everything.

articles.title: Lourdes Gurriel Jr., integral to D-Backs’ 2023 World Series run, designated for assignment
articles.description: "The discussion last night with Lourdes was painful for all of us," Torey Lovullo said. "He's meant so much to this organization." ...

articles.title: Diamondbacks’ Corbin Burnes returns from Tommy John surgery, pitches 3 scoreless innings
articles.description: Burnes tossed three scoreless innings Tuesday night against the Kansas City Royals, his first big-league start in over 450 days.
